"I wanted a room where the music doesn't have to explain itself. Where comedy doesn't have to be safe. Where artists feel like they're home."

A decade in Cape Town's nightlife, from booking acts in backrooms to building The One Room from nothing. Nomakhosini created a space that doesn't compromise — for artists or for the people who come to listen.
